checks.title: Confirm close owner
checks.instructions: Verify whether this is the Crew's primary role or an added capability, the entity and close owner, and the independent reviewer if any. Preserve an existing Crew identity.

checks.title: Verify the close skill
checks.instructions: Confirm skills/revenue-close-analyst/SKILL.md exists and revenue-close-analyst is selected for this Crew.

checks.title: Set period and accounting basis
checks.instructions: Agree on fiscal period, timezone, reporting currency, accounting method, materiality threshold, and company revenue policy. Record stable choices in MEMORY.md; leave unknown treatment open for an accountant.

checks.title: Verify source records
checks.instructions: Read representative authorized billing, credit/refund, ledger, and revenue schedule records or exports for the period. Record which are missing and do not claim a full close when a required source is absent.

checks.title: Map IDs and accounts
checks.instructions: Confirm customer, contract, subscription, invoice, credit, payment, and ledger identifiers, chart-of-account mapping, and opening balances on a sample.

checks.title: Test a reconciliation
checks.instructions: Reconcile a sample across billed, collected, credited, recognized, and deferred amounts with period cutoffs, currency, fees, and rounding explained. Record unexplained variances.

checks.title: Review the first close memo
checks.instructions: Produce a dated close checklist, source-linked exception table, calculations, and review status. Complete only after the owner or accountant reviews the result.

checks.title: Decide on close handoff
checks.instructions: Choose chat-only or an approved accountant/finance handoff. Chat-only completes this decision. Do not deliver records elsewhere without authorization.

checks.title: Decide on recurring close
checks.instructions: Choose no recurrence, a reviewed period schedule, or an authenticated event source. No recurrence completes this decision. Configure and test separately before enabling.
